set.header: How posts are built on this blog
set.bodytext: Each post on this blog is a page in TYPO3 v14. Editors enter the title, teaser, date, author, categories and tags in the page properties. The text itself is made of content elements, the same ones you use on any other page. Once a post is published, the Blog extension lists it on the start page. It also appears on the matching category, tag and author pages, and in the archive. Readers can comment below each post, and editors approve or remove comments in the backend. To see how a finished post looks, read the other posts on this blog.

set.header: What editors fill in for each post
set.bodytext:
• A short title that says what the post is about.

  • An abstract of one sentence for the post list.

  • A meta description for search engines and social previews.

  • Links to other pages, such as the Camino packing list on another demo site.

  • A publish date, which decides where the post appears in the archive.
